resources.string: Use your TV as a separate Mac display, or mirror your iPhone or iPad.
720p / 30 fps preview with audio. Use Screen Mirroring or AirPlay audio on your trusted local network.

Background listening accepts new connections while playback is closed. Keep session connected preserves an existing connection when you leave; turning it off ends that session. Background audio allows sound while playback is hidden and requires a retained session. Auto-open video opens incoming video when Android permits. These options apply until the receiver service exits; listening does not start after reboot. Stop ends the session and turns listening off.
